Choose the JSON implementation

Source: R/json.R
zu_set_json_backend.Rd

zuhttp has no hard dependencies. zu_body_json() and zu_resp_json() use jsonlite if it is installed, and this replaces it with anything else.

zu_set_json_backend(encode = NULL, decode = NULL)

Arguments

encode

A function (x, ...) returning a single JSON string. Must accept ..., since request-level options are forwarded to it.

decode

A function (txt, ...) returning an R object.

Value

The previous backend, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zu_set_json_backend(
  encode = function(x, ...) RcppSimdJson::serialize(x),
  decode = function(txt, ...) RcppSimdJson::fparse(txt)
)
} # }
